                            NEW YORK STATE SENATE





                                     THE

                             STENOGRAPHIC RECORD









                              ALBANY, NEW YORK

                              December 13, 2004

                                 10:00 a.m.





                               REGULAR SESSION





                 SENATOR JOSEPH L. BRUNO, Acting President

                 STEVEN M. BOGGESS, Secretary









                                                        6338





                      P R O C E E D I N G S

                      ACTING PRESIDENT BRUNO:  Senate will

                 come to order.

                      The Secretary will begin by reading the

                 Journal.

                      THE SECRETARY:  In Session, Friday,

                 December 10, 2004.  The Senate met pursuant

                 to adjournment.  The Journal of Wednesday,

                 December 8, 2004, was read and approved.  On

                 motion, the Senate adjourned.

                      ACTING PRESIDENT BRUNO:  Hearing no

                 objection, the Journal will stand approved

                 as read.

                      The order of business:

                      Presentation of petitions.

                      Messages from the Assembly.

                      Messages from the Governor.

                      Reports of standing committees.

                      Reports of select committees.

                      Communications and reports from state

                 officers.

                      Motions and resolutions.

                      Calendar.

                      Special orders.

                                                        6339



                      Committee notices.

                      There being no further business to come

                 before the Senate, we'll stand adjourned.

                      (Whereupon, at 10:05 a.m., the Senate

                 adjourned.)
